subject: Sagepoint onboarding: service account patterns, SCIM schema, and IP cadence
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.r@sagepoint.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana McClure <dana.mcclure@sagepoint.io>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: Sagepoint access kickoff and SCIM sample

Hey Priyom / Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick intro call today — appreciate the walkthrough. We want to lock down the implementation cooking plan for next three weeks: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlist windows, and the service-account model for automation. A few asks from security:

- Can you confirm expected SCIM schema (attributes) so our IdP team can map now?
- For IP allowlists, we need a maintenance cadence and a rollback/whitelist emergency contact.
- Service accounts: we expect short-lived keys or token rotation guidance and whether Redwood can support a delegated provisioning flow.

Attaching a current SCIM CSV we have for other vendors — it's rough but will help. We’re aiming to start SAML metadata exchange 3/8 and SCIM dry-run 3/18.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
IT Manager — Sagepoint
security@sagepoint.io

Attachment: sagepoint-scim-schema.csv (CSV, 4KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.r@sagepoint.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Sagepoint access kickoff and SCIM sample

Alex — thanks for the note and the CSV. Quick responses inline and a proposed handoff plan below.

SCIM schema: Monica has a one-page mapping that aligns with Redwood's provisioning API (user.active, user.username, user.name.given, user.name.family, emails[type=work], groups, externalId). Monica: I’ll pull the spreadsheet and post the canonical mapping.

IP allowlist cadence: Ben, can you confirm our published egress IP ranges and suggested maintenance windows? We typically recommend a weekly maintenance window (Thu 02:00–04:00 UTC) with a 30-minute rollback lane. For emergencies we use sec-ops@redwood.com on-call + a dedicated escalation number.

Service accounts: Redwood supports scoped service accounts with token rotation. For Sagepoint, we recommend two patterns:
  1) Per-environment long-lived service account with automated rotation via KMS (team-managed keys).
  2) Ephemeral delegated provisioning where the IdP issues short-lived tokens via SCIM-triggered provisioning — this requires your IdP to support OAuth client credential flow and the ability to attach metadata.

Proposed milestones:
- 3/08: SAML metadata exchange + test IdP sandbox
- 3/12: Redwood sends SCIM client credentials and canonical schema (dry-run data spec)
- 3/18: SCIM dry-run (10 test users) + service-account provisioning test
- 3/25: IP allowlist cutover & smoke tests

I’m attaching our SSO checklist and an example service-account CSV for your provisioning team. Would love to align on timeboxes for each milestone.

Best,
Priyom Das
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sso-checklist.pdf (PDF, 12KB); svcacct-patterns-v1.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.r@sagepoint.io>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 09:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Sagepoint access kickoff and SCIM sample

Alex — uploaded the canonical mapping to the shared Drive (link below). Key notes for your IdP team:

- Required attributes: id (externalId), userName, name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work], active (boolean).
- Groups: Redwood expects group displayName + externalId for group sync. If your IdP cannot send externalId, we can map on displayName but risk collisions.
- SCIM rate limits: to avoid gaps during initial sync, we recommend batching group adds in 100-user chunks.

Service account pattern (concrete):
- Recommended: "svc-redwood-prod" per tenant with metadata tags (owner, rotation_schedule=7d). Tokens rotate via our KMS integration and can be scoped to either read-only embeddings or generation endpoints.
- If you want ephemeral credentials, the delegated provisioning requires a small integration (OAuth client credentials + a webhook on your side). We can scope an engineer pairing session if you want to pursue that.

IP allowlist ops: Ben will provide the public IP ranges and a one-pager on maintenance windows + rollback steps. Neha, can you confirm whether Sagepoint requires audit-log retention beyond standard 30 days? If so, we should capture that as a separate requirement for Private/Dedicated options.

See drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-sagepoint-onboard

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex.r@sagepoint.io>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana McClure <dana.mcclure@sagepoint.io>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Sagepoint access kickoff and SCIM sample

Thanks Priyom / Monica — this is exactly what we needed. A few follow-ups from our side:

- We can do SAML metadata exchange on 3/08 at 14:00 PT. I'll send calendar invite to Priyom and Monica.
- Our IdP (Okta) supports externalId for groups but we need to confirm format — I’ll send a cleaned SCIM sample.
- Audit retention: our compliance team requested 90-day logs for provisioning events and 365-day for admin policy changes. Can you capture that as an option in the runbook?

One more ask: during the 3/18 SCIM dry-run, would Redwood accept a small randomized set of test emails (e.g., user1+test@sagepoint.io) instead of real users to avoid noise?

Dana will follow up with an updated SCIM CSV and calendar invites.

—Alex

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.r@sagepoint.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Mar 2026 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial: Sagepoint access kickoff and SCIM sample

Perfect — calendar invite received for 3/08 14:00 PT. Quick confirmations and next steps:

- Monica will host the SAML metadata exchange and provide the SAML test SP metadata (xml) ahead of the call.
- Ben will publish IP ranges and the maintenance/rollback playbook by 3/06 EOD.
- Neha will draft the audit-retention options: default 30d, premium 90d/365d tiers and what those mean for Dedicated/Private.
- For 3/18 SCIM dry-run: we are fine with the randomized test accounts. Please send a sample CSV (10 rows) with externalId and emails pointing to your test domain.

Action items:
- Alex/Dana: share cleaned SCIM sample + confirm Okta externalId format (due 3/06).
- Redwood (Monica/Ben/Neha): deliver SP metadata, IP ranges doc, and retention options (due 3/06).
- Priyom: I’ll own the mutual action plan and will send the tracked milestone doc after this reply.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Priyom Das

Redwood Inference
